description: The morning check: everything that needs the user's attention about delivery. Posts that failed or partially failed in the last `days` days with each platform's error and fix, connections whose health went dead or degraded, pending approvals whose slot is within 48 h or already passed, approvals that expired (their posts are drafts again), scheduled posts in the next 7 days that would fail preflight if dispatched now, auto-import content sources that stopped fetching, and posting queues with free slots this week while drafts wait. Same data as the 08:00 digest e-mail. Empty `hasIssues: false` means nothing to do.

days.description: Look-back window in days for failures and connection changes (default 1)

name: get_delivery_report
